policy.natural_earth_use: geography_and_cartography_only; never a source for WP1.5 statistics or classifications
policy.observation_scope: one current observation per country and statistic; retain source reference period and distinguish observed, estimated, projected, unavailable, and not_applicable
policy.missing_values: never infer or fill; explicit unavailable/not_applicable may be stored as NULL with status; absent rows remain missing for the final completeness audit
policy.raw_data_version_control: local_only; track manifests, URLs, retrieval timestamps, release identifiers, and SHA-256 checksums in Git
policy.source_status: candidate sources require field-level coverage, definitions, update cadence, download format, and terms verification before production acquisition

un_wpp_2024.name: UN World Population Prospects 2024
un_wpp_2024.notes: Population, growth, age/sex distributions and migration. Country/area coverage is not identical to the 242 game identities; explicit crosswalk and coverage accounting required.

imf_weo.name: IMF World Economic Outlook
imf_weo.notes: GDP, GDP per capita, PPP GDP, inflation and unemployment; distinguish actuals, estimates and projections and retain WEO vintage.

world_bank_wdi.name: World Bank World Development Indicators
world_bank_wdi.notes: Candidate secondary/alternative indicator source. Preserve indicator code, country coverage, reference year and dataset vintage.

ilostat.name: ILOSTAT
ilostat.notes: Preferred specialist source for labour force and labour-market definitions; retain series and sex/age breakdown metadata.

faostat.name: FAOSTAT
faostat.notes: Candidate source for land/area and selected agriculture/forestry/resource measures; confirm indicator definitions and country coverage.

koppen_beck_2023.name: Beck et al. Köppen-Geiger V3
koppen_beck_2023.notes: Spatial raster, not a single categorical country value. Derive country-level area shares or distributions using the project geometry and retain period/scenario/resolution.

fao_fra_2025.name: FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment 2025
fao_fra_2025.notes: Use reported reference-year forest area; do not conflate forest area with tree cover.

usgs_mcs_2026.name: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026
usgs_mcs_2026.notes: Covers more than 90 nonfuel mineral commodities, but global country-level production/reserve coverage varies by commodity. Not a complete natural-resource inventory.

pew_religion_2020.name: Pew Research Center Global Religious Composition dataset
pew_religion_2020.notes: Seven broad categories; estimates for 201 and territories with population >=100,000 in 2010 or 2020. Use rounded counts for reporting small groups.

undp_hdr.name: UNDP Human Development Reports statistical data
undp_hdr.notes: Use HDI and its reported reference year, not report publication year.

itu.name: ITU DataHub
itu.notes: Preferred specialist source for internet-use indicators; check country coverage and reference period.

who_ghed.name: WHO Global Health Expenditure Database
who_ghed.notes: Health expenditure indicators and financing breakdowns; retain current dataset vintage and reference year.

world_bank_pip.name: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform
world_bank_pip.notes: Poverty and Gini measures depend on survey year, poverty line and welfare concept; do not treat missing survey years as zero.

world_bank_wgi.name: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators 2026
world_bank_wgi.notes: Political stability is an estimate, not a definitive rating. Some standardized underlying source values cannot be redistributed without third-party authorization.

official_government_sources.name: Official national government and constitutional sources
official_government_sources.notes: No single global dataset is assumed. Record the specific official URL, authority, effective date, and classification rationale per country.

official_organization_registers.name: Official intergovernmental organization membership registers
official_organization_registers.notes: Membership must be checked against each organization's official membership list and an explicit as-of date.

iiss_military_balance.name: IISS The Military Balance
iiss_military_balance.notes: Candidate specialist source for active/reserve personnel and force structure; subscription and redistribution terms require review.

sipri_milex.name: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database
sipri_milex.notes: Commercial use requires authorization/licensing; annual series and observation year must be retained.

global_carbon_project.name: Global Carbon Project Global Carbon Budget
global_carbon_project.notes: Confirm country-level per-capita series, methodology and download terms before selecting the exact table.

energy_institute.name: Energy Institute Statistical Review of World Energy 2026
energy_institute.notes: CSV/XLSX consolidated data and archives are available. Retain edition/vintage; historical values may be revised between editions.

protected_planet.name: Protected Planet WDPA / GD-PAME
protected_planet.notes: Commercial use requires prior written permission; redistribution is restricted. Store only after explicit field-level decision on whether aggregate derived indicators are permitted.

fao_aquastat.name: FAO AQUASTAT
fao_aquastat.notes: Candidate source for water resources and water stress; indicator coverage and reporting years vary.

selection_count_reconciliation.note: The owner confirmed that the intended WP1.5 scope is the 41 distinct field IDs enumerated in this contract. Religion (48) and Gini index (56) are included. No additional fields are to be invented.
